summary: A work item ended as failed: an attempt failed with nothing left worth trying, or a person rejected the work while it waited for their approval.

key.description: The attempt that failed, by its id; `status` where a person's rejection ended the work.

new.description: The item's last error: the attempt's error without its trace, which stays on the attempt.

code.description: What went wrong, as a snake_case code.

message.description: What went wrong, in words for a person.

retriable.description: The runtime's judgement of whether the failure was worth another attempt; a failure worth one still ends the item when no attempts are left.

details.description: The fields a refused request named, where the failure was about specific fields.

class.description: The class a plugin gave the failure where it answered for a provider; absent where the runtime classified the failure itself.

block.description: What the provider block said, on a failure of class `blocked` whose block holds to the provider-block contract. Its shape is the one that contract publishes, docs/contracts/block/provider_block.json, and is not repeated here.
